hackathon.transcript: Okay so today was the YC hackathon. Got to the office at like nine, the whole team crammed around one table by the window, way too many Red Bulls. Danny and I argued about the database for twenty minutes. Around sunset we finally got the first world to render and everybody screamed. Ate cold pizza on the floor.
hackathon.title: The first world renders
hackathon.weather: clear, golden light through big windows

Warm golden sunset light through the window. Stylized 3D animated-film look, soft clay-like materials, warm cinematic light, isometric three-quarter view, centered, plain white background.

santa-cruz.transcript: Took the day off and drove to Santa Cruz with Maya. Foggy in the morning but it cleared up around noon. We rented bikes, rode along the cliffs, saw like a hundred surfers. Got clam chowder in a bread bowl on the wharf and watched the sea lions yelling at each other. Sunburnt now.
santa-cruz.title: Cliffs, surfers, sea lions
santa-cruz.weather: sunny, last wisps of morning fog over the water
santa-cruz.palette: ocean blue, sand, cypress green, sun-bleached wood
santa-cruz.concept_prompt: A cozy miniature diorama of the Santa Cruz coast on a small round floating island base: a wooden wharf on stilts over the water with sea lions lounging on the beams, two rental bikes parked on a cliffside path, tiny surfers riding waves below the cliffs, a little chowder stand with a bread bowl sign, thin fog clearing into a sunny noon. Stylized 3D animated-film look, soft clay-like materials, warm cinematic light, isometric three-quarter view, centered, plain white background.

Stylized 3D animated-film look, soft clay-like materials, warm cinematic light, wide angle.
